$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHO (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Aubenas Ardèche méridionale

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio equipped ACFT Preferred QFU 002° due to environment.
LDG RWY 18: do not descend below 1000 ft AAL until lining up on final APCH.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Caution advised when taxiing due to presence of civil safety equipment close to the TWY.
TWY civil protection is unusable when pelicandrome is active.
Parallel TWY reserved as a priority for Civil Safety ACFT.
South hangars service way: maximum wingspan of 12 meters, maximum landing gear width of 4 meters.
Avoid overflying Balazuc located south of AD.
PAPI mandatory by night.
LDG RWY 18 prohibited by night.
PCL: 3 clicks on mic: edge lighting, windsock, signs, PAPI,; 5 clicks on mic: edge lighting, windsock, signs, flashing lights,; 7 clicks on mic: shutdown.
PJE on AD (NR 412): FL 135; SAT, SUN and public HOL; Daytime except when LF-R 55 C or D are active.
Aerobatics over AD (NR 6810): when LF-R 55 D is inactive: 2600 ft AMSL / FL 060; HJ on SAT, SUN and public HOL, PPR from ORANGE APP 118.925.
AEM on AD (NR 9635): 500 ft ASFC, SR-SS.
As per protocol.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio. QFU 002° préférentiel cause environnement.
LDG RWY 18 : ne descendre au-dessous de 1000 ft AAL qu'après alignement sur l'axe de piste.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Prudence au roulage en raison de la présence d'équipements sécurité civile en bordure du TWY.
Le TWY protection civile est inutilisable si le pélicandrome est activé.
Le TWY parallèle à la piste est réservé en priorité aux avions de la Sécurité Civile.
Voie de desserte hangars Sud : envergure maximale 12 mètres, largeur de train maximale 4 mètres.
Éviter le survol de Balazuc situé au sud.
PAPI obligatoire de nuit.
Atterrissage RWY 18 interdit de nuit.
PCL : 3 coups d'alternat : balisage latéral, manche à air, panneaux, PAPI ; 5 coups d'alternat : balisage latéral, manche à air, panneaux, feux à éclats ; 7 coups d'alternat : extinction.
Parachutage sur AD (N° 412) : FL 135 ; SAM, DIM et JF ; HJ sauf si LF-R 55 C ou D actives.
Voltige sur AD (N° 6810) : lorsque LF-R 55 D inactive : 2600 ft AMSL / FL 060 ; HJ les SAM, DIM et JF et sur autorisation de ORANGE APP 118.925.
AEM sur AD (N° 9635) : 500 ft ASFC, SR-SS.
Selon protocole.
